a: Sparks age on a wall-clock gap times `m.rate`, not on the mix's clock, so a panel pause, a hold rate, or a seek doesn't reach them
Auto-launch is timed on `performance.now()` in the frame loop, so it keeps launching while the panel holds the mix paused
Without the in-page panel the mix has no `history`, so the DevTools extension can't seek it
A double-click on "Start the show" builds two sound graphs, two drivers and two frame loops
Overlapping bangs share one panner and one mono NoiseSynth and MembraneSynth, so a second shell moves the first's ringing tail to its own side
The sky box loses its 16:9 shape on a narrow viewport, while the camera stays 16:9, so the show is drawn stretched
b: Sparks age on frame gap × `m.rate`, not on mix time, so the panel's pause and any hold leave them moving
"Keep launching" times launches on the frame loop's own wall clock, and keeps launching while the mix is paused
The mix has no `history`, so the panel can't seek the demo
Clicking "Start the show" twice before `Tone.start()` resolves starts the show twice
Overlapping shells share one panner, so a later bang re-pans an earlier one still sounding
